prakriti.note: Data extracted strictly from Charaka Samhita Chikitsasthana Chapters 27-29. These chapters describe dosha characteristics in the context of disease (vikruti/covering states), not pure prakriti assessment. Only statements directly from the text are included.

physical: Rough and dry skin when vayu is in twak
Cracked skin when vayu is in twak
Benumbed and thin skin when vayu is in twak
Body parts dry up when vayu is aggravated
Emaciation (leanness) when vayu is in rakta
Wasting of body parts in vatika disorders
mental: Mental confusion when vayu is vitiated
Fear as a causative and associated factor
Diminution of intellect when vyana is covered by prana
Diminution of memory when vyana is covered by prana
Diminution of strength when vyana is covered by prana
digestive: Anorexia as symptom of vitiated vayu
Gurgling sound in intestines when vayu in pakvasaya
Hardness in bowels when vayu in pakvasaya
Digestive fire diminishes in vyana covered by samana
Diarrhoea when prana is covered by apana
vata.sleep: Sleeplessness is a symptom of vitiated vayu (vata in asthi/majja)
vata.speech: Speech becomes feeble and impeded in ardita (facial paralysis); stammering and dumbness when samana is covered by prana
vata.memory: Diminution of memory when vyana is covered by prana
emotional: Fear as causative factor in vata aggravation
disease_tendency: Stiffness in hands, back and head
Destruction of foetus, sperms and ovum
aggravated_signs: Quivering and breaking pain in limbs
Pain aggravated by rough and cold things

physical: Burning sensation when pitta covers vayu
Excessive sweating when samana is covered by pitta
Redness and inflammation in vata-pitta conditions
Yellow colour of urine and stool when apana covered by pitta
Heat in anus and penis when apana covered by pitta
mental: Feeling of darkness when pitta covers vayu
digestive: Burning after meals in paittika vatarakta
Burning sensation in navel and chest when udana covered by pitta
Excessive menstrual discharge when apana covered by pitta
emotional: Restlessness from heat affliction when samana covered by pitta
aggravated_signs: Aggravation by pungent, sour, salty and hot things

physical: Absence of sweating when samana covered by kapha
Excessive coldness of body parts when samana covered by kapha
Heaviness in body when vyana covered by kapha
mental: Drowsiness as feature of vata-kapha conditions (Gridhrasi)
Fainting and drowsiness when vyana covered by samana
Delirium when vyana covered by samana
digestive: Poor digestion when samana covered by kapha
Stool passed as broken associated with ama and kapha (mucus) when apana covered by kapha
Heavy stool when apana covered by kapha
Appearance of kaphaja meha when apana covered by kapha
kapha.sleep: Excessive sleep (Nidra) - mentioned as prodrome of Urustambha
kapha.speech: Obstruction in speech and voice when udana covered by kapha; abnormal complexion and debility
aggravated_signs: Pain reduced by pungent, dry and hot things
Particular desire for fasting and exertion
Itching and moistening (in kapha-rakta type vatarakta)

vata_pitta: Cold and hot measures should be applied alternately in treatment
Burning sensation with dilatation and quivering in vatarakta
Association of burning with pain and roughness
pitta_kapha: Prana and udana covered by kapha and pitta are considered serious
When kapha comes into stomach with pitta spreading, both emesis and purgation needed
Pitta should be overcome first before kapha when both are combined with vata
vata_kapha: Non-unctuous and unctuous enemas with cow's urine eliminate vata-kapha
In Gridhrasi with vata-kapha: drowsiness, heaviness and anorexia additionally
In Urustambha: kapha with medas subdues vata and pitta
Barley food, wild animals, sudation, strong non-unctuous enema, emesis, purgation, old ghee and mustard oil are wholesome in vata with kapha

sama_prakriti: Person whose vayu is with unimpeded movements and in normal state lives long for hundred years devoid of disorders (Charaka Samhita Ch. XXVIII verse 4) - this describes ideal balanced state
All five types of vata in equilibrium and located in their places perform normal functions by which the body is sustained free from disorders
